title: Full three-loop renormalisation of an abelian chiral gauge theory with non-anticommuting gamma5 in the BMHV scheme
journal: none listed on arXiv page (published version not verified)
claim: Complete three-loop counterterm action of right-handed chiral QED (Tr(Y_R^3) = 0) in BMHV via the QAP. New UV-divergent BRST-breaking structures appear first at three loops: a non-evanescent divergent gauge bilinear and a non-evanescent quartic gauge term (eq. 4.1, 4.5, 4.11), and a 1/eps^2 breaking in the fermion self-energy (eq. A.13); higher poles appear. Finite restoring counterterms (eq. 4.12) have the same three structures as at one and two loops (Abar dbar^2 Abar, Abar^4, psibar i dslashbar P_R psi) with new coefficients (eqs. A.7, A.9, A.15). Some divergent and finite counterterms cannot be generated by multiplicative renormalization.
scheme: BMHV DREG, sterile left-handed partner, purely 4-dim gauge coupling; all-massive tadpole infrared rearrangement with auxiliary mass counterterms; Feynman gauge at three loops.

proved: Complete three-loop counterterm action for the model (internal consistency checks: Green-function vs insertion results agree, logarithms cancel).
checked_partially: Three loops only in Feynman gauge.

evidence: Sec. 4: eqs. (4.1)-(4.12); App. A: coefficients (A.4)-(A.15); App. C: sign/factor correction relative to earlier reference.
eq. (4.8): ghost-double-gauge function proportional to Tr(Y_R^3) eps, vanishes by anomaly cancellation.
red_flags: Tr(Y_R^5) appears in fermion coefficients (eqs. A.12, A.14, A.15) without discussion as a condition.
Assignment of the fermion breaking to bilinears is a convention (Sec. 4.3).
